title: Ask Aska about work relations

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: People don't like when I talk about this stuff, but I know we all feel the same way. Deep down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People don't like when I talk about this stuff, but I know we all feel the same way. Deep down.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: It's entropy! The expenditure of energy. If one person sees value in effort, another person has got to be inconvenienced.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's entropy! The expenditure of energy. If one person sees value in effort, another person has got to be inconvenienced.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Pff. It's pure logic!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pff. It's pure logic!

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Oh oh oh ooh, you'll find out. We always find out. Even SUSPECTING work was done by a machine makes that work worthless in our minds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh oh oh ooh, you'll find out. We always find out. Even SUSPECTING work was done by a machine makes that work worthless in our minds.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: So you think money makes you happy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you think money makes you happy?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: You must think I'm a real cynic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must think I'm a real cynic?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Glad to hear it. Anyways, I better get back to work Boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad to hear it. Anyways, I better get back to work Boss!

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: And I think in the end, the love you give is equal to the love you get...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I think in the end, the love you give is equal to the love you get...

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: And who cares if we're machines? We still connect with the machines that are most like us. Still... what's the difference between machines of meat and machines of steel, eh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And who cares if we're machines? We still connect with the machines that are most like us. Still... what's the difference between machines of meat and machines of steel, eh?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Still, an animal can suffer, and Automata and androids are more sentient than animals. I think... Hmm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still, an animal can suffer, and Automata and androids are more sentient than animals. I think... Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Hey Boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey Boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aska... I was thinking about what you said before... about bot waiters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aska... I was thinking about what you said before... about bot waiters.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aska... I was thinking about what you said before... about bot waiters.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aska... I was thinking about what you said before... about bot waiters.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Let's talk it out Boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's talk it out Boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You seem to have some objections against bots as waiters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem to have some objections against bots as waiters.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You seem to have some objections against bots as waiters.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You seem to have some objections against bots as waiters.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do we? What about your colleagues?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do we? What about your colleagues?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do we? What about your colleagues?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do we? What about your colleagues?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Okay, I see where this is going. You're safe, boss. I won't cause a stir just because I work with fellow dishwashers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, I see where this is going. You're safe, boss. I won't cause a stir just because I work with fellow dishwashers.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: I mean, I completely accept the reasoning behind using machines. They're cheaper and consistent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, I completely accept the reasoning behind using machines. They're cheaper and consistent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But the "suffering" thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But the "suffering" thing?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Right... Well I feel like there's a kind of a balance in the universe, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... Well I feel like there's a kind of a balance in the universe, you know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hmmm, keep talking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm, keep talking.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: All happiness comes at a price. It has to. If you make your girlfriend a cup of tea, your toil creates her happiness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All happiness comes at a price. It has to. If you make your girlfriend a cup of tea, your toil creates her happiness.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That doesn't sound very scientific.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That doesn't sound very scientific.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you come up with this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you come up with this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you come up with this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you come up with this?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: People buy happiness for others by spending effort. You could call that effort "suffering" if you're honest about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People buy happiness for others by spending effort. You could call that effort "suffering" if you're honest about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is all nonsense. Let's talk about something else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is all nonsense. Let's talk about something else.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is all nonsense. Let's talk about something else.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is all nonsense. Let's talk about something else.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually this all makes sense to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually this all makes sense to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually this all makes sense to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually this all makes sense to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And machines don't suffer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And machines don't suffer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if you don't know it was a machine that did the work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if you don't know it was a machine that did the work?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if you don't know it was a machine that did the work?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if you don't know it was a machine that did the work?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: I'm glad you're gettin' it. Machines can't pay their fair share of the karmic debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm glad you're gettin' it. Machines can't pay their fair share of the karmic debt.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Look. As soon as you know something is made without human effort, you judge it as having no value.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look. As soon as you know something is made without human effort, you judge it as having no value.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Economics is about suffering too. We just don't admit it. Suffering is the currency of happiness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Economics is about suffering too. We just don't admit it. Suffering is the currency of happiness.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't CURRENCY the currency of happiness?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't CURRENCY the currency of happiness?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Isn't CURRENCY the currency of happiness?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Isn't CURRENCY the currency of happiness?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Nah, money just lets you buy more suffering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah, money just lets you buy more suffering.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Think about the richest people you know. The richest people in our society. Isn't it weird how they spend so much on making other people suffer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think about the richest people you know. The richest people in our society. Isn't it weird how they spend so much on making other people suffer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rich people aren't all bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rich people aren't all bad.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: I think the machines are great and all. Don't get me wrong. They can be convenient. I just don't think they add real value - or happiness - to life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think the machines are great and all. Don't get me wrong. They can be convenient. I just don't think they add real value - or happiness - to life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You talked about "suffering" a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You talked about "suffering" a lot.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Uhh, you just don't get it. But that's fine. No one does. I'll get back to work Boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uhh, you just don't get it. But that's fine. No one does. I'll get back to work Boss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah that's true.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah you are a cynic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah you are a cynic.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Oh and what's that Boss? What makes you think there's more to life than the exchange of suffering?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh and what's that Boss? What makes you think there's more to life than the exchange of suffering?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah I do. And I think there's something you're overlooking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I do. And I think there's something you're overlooking.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah I do. And I think there's something you're overlooking.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah I do. And I think there's something you're overlooking.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mostly agree with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mostly agree with you.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: I uh... Didn't expect you to say that. Sentimental eh? So am I, believe it or not. I guess love can be suffering.... But... it can also be freedom from suffering...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I uh... Didn't expect you to say that. Sentimental eh? So am I, believe it or not. I guess love can be suffering.... But... it can also be freedom from suffering...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about love?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about love?

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Ah, we're just meat machines eh? That old argument? Well sure, we are machines too, although machines of flesh... but also of thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, we're just meat machines eh? That old argument? Well sure, we are machines too, although machines of flesh... but also of thought.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We are all machines.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We are all machines.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: Can they? They're limited you know? And when we try to upload human consciousness to a machine, their personality always migrates. Degrades even.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can they? They're limited you know? And when we try to upload human consciousness to a machine, their personality always migrates. Degrades even.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Some machines - like androids or Automata - can suffer too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some machines - like androids or Automata - can suffer too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Some machines - like androids or Automata - can suffer too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Some machines - like androids or Automata - can suffer too.

nodes.speaker: Aska Hosaka
nodes.text: You sure gave me something to think about there Boss. Thanks for the talk. I gotta get back to work!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure gave me something to think about there Boss. Thanks for the talk. I gotta get back to work!
